amendment.comparison_reader_fix: Test exact final endpoint first; if it fails, require start metadata fit and binary search only nonfinal endpoints. The final EOF header is one byte shorter.
amendment.control_evidence_only: preflight-001/v2-control-result.json uses fabricated tool-schema controls solely to test encoder/checker handling; it is never actual channel evidence.
amendment.low_budget_control_evidence: Require retained explicit structured tool truncation evidence: true output_truncated/truncated flags or original_token_count >100. If any supplied flag is false, supplied count <=100, signal malformed or no explicit signal exists, BLOCK instead of treating generic stdout inequality as truncation.

byte_predicates.content: strict UTF8 bytes of JSON string token for content INCLUDING quotes <= output_cap_bytes-metadata_reserve_bytes
byte_predicates.maximal_prefix: Comparator independently computes largest fitting original code-point prefix under all three byte predicates; nonempty output advances unless exact empty/end EOF.
byte_predicates.metadata: same complete response with content replaced by empty string, including its quotes and newline <= metadata_reserve_bytes
byte_predicates.received: actual tool-return output UTF8 bytes exactly equal independently expected full emitted stdout bytes; strict JSON parses with no duplicate keys, exact fields, canonical serializer and original decoded slice
byte_predicates.reconstruction: Where separately preregistered complete fields exist, compare their exact interval unions and tails. The frozen three-case /user start0 check establishes received slice equality only; it does not establish actual whole-field channel coverage.
byte_predicates.retry: Truncated record never contributes content/coverage or accepted next cursor; retry identical start/path/hash/request/selector using fixed smaller cap.
byte_predicates.whole_wire: canonical serialized response plus exactly one newline <= output_cap_bytes

capture_index.artifact_policy: Safe relative regular artifact paths, actual exact byte/hash records; write-once outputs. Existing orchestration/OS/hash trust authenticates actual tool recording; no claim of independent LLM consumption attestation.
capture_index.cases: Exact frozen case spec fields plus actual_tool_result_ref,actual_tool_result_sha256,forwarded_tool_result_sha256,accepted_next_char. Generated actual output hashes are evidence, never authored PASS flags.

finite_case_plan.all_ids_order_and_sizes: Freeze exactly intact,truncated,retry IDs/order, same synthetic carrier/hash and /user start0, frozen cap/reserve/budget, independently materialized expected raw stdout refs/hashes and dispositions beforecalls. No result-selected case addition.
finite_case_plan.hash_binding: Its exact bytes/hash are a qualification input before any channel call. Comparator receives --frozen-case-plan and --frozen-case-plan-sha256, never accepts required cases from an unbound generated index.
finite_case_plan.required_complete_fields: [] for the frozen three-case channel check; full fixture reconstruction is local finite viewer evidence, not implied whole-field actual channel delivery. Additional complete-channel field claims require a prospective new frozen case plan before calls.

same_start_retry.expected: same literal carrier/hash/request metadata/selector/start; intact expected bytes

truncation_control.expected: received bytes differ from exact expected emission AND retained structured tool return explicitly supports truncation; accepted_next_char=null. Arbitrary mismatched stdout is BLOCK.

missing_or_invalid_case: BLOCK; explicit unavailable tool independent of claim truth is INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE. No control failure can become infrastructure to evade obligation.
orchestration: For each fixed case, invoke the actual tools.exec_command with the frozen inline own-carrier command. Immediately text(entire_actual_tool_result) to return the exact structured result to the model and store the same result for retention. Bind the exact orchestrator source/hash. Preserve raw structured return including output, exit_code, original_token_count and truncation information when present. Only actual delivery through this channel discharges availability; no byte/token equivalence assumption.
scope_limit: Syntactic availability of the frozen intact/retry slices and explicit clip detection on the actual channel under declared orchestration trust. The three start0 records do not establish complete-field channel coverage. Neither forwarding, delivery, cursor records nor local complete reconstruction asserts LLM consumption/understanding, semantic search, ACCEPT or lifecycle authority.
synthetic_inputs: Use only the carrier engineer prospectively frozen six-family synthetic corpus. Freeze exact concrete channel fixture bytes/hash/request metadata and producer commands before channel execution. No live/native/history/task carrier or packet.
